reports.title: Business Register
reports.description: Statistics Canada's continuously maintained central repository of baseline information on businesses and institutions operating in Canada (IMDB record 1105). It is the sampling frame from which most of the agency's economic surveys draw their populations, and every establishment on it carries a NAICS industry code.
reports.cadence_note: The register is maintained continuously; published outputs from it (business counts) are released twice per year.

entries.covers: Canadian business counts / Business Register data, June 2026
Canadian business counts / Business Register data, December 2026 (projected)

release_schedule.rule: The Canadian business counts (the public release product of the Business Register, SDDS 1105) are produced semi-annually for each June and December reference period, and the data are released in August and February.
release_schedule.note: StatCan's Business Register (SDDS 1105) itself is a continuously-updated internal database, but its public release product 'Canadian business counts' is published twice a year, matching the corpus's releases_per_year=2. Confirmed releases: June 2025 data released 2025-08-15, December 2025 data released 2026-02-13. The official StatCan release schedule (cal2-eng.htm) lists 'Canadian business counts, June 2026' as upcoming on 2026-08-14. The following release (December 2026 data) is projected via the stated semi-annual pattern and is not yet on the published calendar.

reports.title: Annual Survey of Service Industries: Amusement and Recreation
reports.description: Annual survey of establishments in NAICS subsector 713 (amusement, gambling and recreation industries), IMDB record 2425. Narrowed from the handoff's umbrella 'Annual Survey of Service Industries (and sub-surveys)' node to the specific survey the evidence record describes; it stands here as the documented example of the ASSI family pattern of drawing NAICS-coded establishments from the Business Register.

entries.covers: Amusement and recreation industry, 2025 reference year

release_schedule.note: StatCan does not publish a fixed release calendar for this annual survey; releases appear in 'The Daily' in the Oct-Dec window of the year following the reference year, per collection period 'March through August (or October per survey page) of the year after the reference period'. Observed past release dates: 2024 ref year -> 2025-12-16; 2023 ref year -> 2024-11-04; 2022 ref year -> 2023-11-14; 2021 ref year -> 2022-11-16; 2019 ref year -> 2020-12-15; 2018 ref year -> 2019-12-12; 2017 ref year -> 2018-12-19; 2011 ref year -> 2013-01-29 (outlier, delayed). Based on this pattern the 2025 reference-year data is expected to release in the Oct-Dec 2026 window; no exact date has been published yet.

reports.title: Canadian International Merchandise Trade (Customs Basis)
reports.description: Monthly customs-basis statistics on Canada's merchandise exports and imports by commodity, province or territory, and partner country (IMDB record 2201). Commodities are classified under the Harmonized System, extended to eight digits for exports and ten digits for imports.

release_schedule.note: Confirmed via both the 'Next release' statement on the June 2026 Daily article (released 2026-08-04, stating July data due 2026-09-03) and StatCan's official 2026-2027 Major Economic Releases calendar PDF, which lists monthly dates through early 2027. Report is released monthly, consistent with the existing releases_per_year=12.

reports.title: Discharge Abstract Database (DAD)
reports.description: CIHI's database of administrative, clinical and demographic information on hospital discharges (and some day surgery) across Canada, released annually. It is the primary vehicle for ICD-10-CA and CCI coded hospital data.

entries.covers: Hospital stays in Canada, 2021–2022 (DAD-based annual report)
Hospital stays in Canada, 2025–2026 (projected next annual DAD-based release)

release_schedule.note: CIHI's DAD metadata page and 'Submission deadlines and refresh dates' page (https://www.cihi.ca/en/submit-data-and-view-standards/submission-deadlines-and-refresh-dates) list quarterly facility submission deadlines for DAD (with Q4/year-end final deadline June 30) but explicitly mark public 'Data refreshed' dates as 'Not applicable' for DAD, i.e., no published release calendar exists for the raw database. However, CIHI publishes an annual public-facing report/analysis built on the newly closed fiscal year's DAD data, 'Hospital stays in Canada' (formerly similar quick-stats/analysis products), consistently in mid-to-late February each year (Feb 23 2023, Feb 22 2024, Feb 20 2025, Feb 19 2026), roughly 11 months after the covered fiscal year (Apr-Mar) ends. This is used as the best available proxy for the DAD's one-release-per-year cadence given no explicit calendar for the raw data asset itself.

reports.title: Harmonized Commodity Description and Coding System (HS)
reports.description: The multipurpose international product nomenclature developed by the World Customs Organization: more than 5,000 commodity groups, each identified by a six-digit code. The commodity-side counterpart to the industry classifications already in this corpus — national trade statistics, including Canada's, are coded to it, with countries adding digits beyond six for tariff and statistical detail.
reports.cadence_note: The WCO's Harmonized System Committee 'prepares amendments updating the HS every 5 – 6 years' — editions 2002, 2007, 2012, 2017, 2022. Not an annual release; releases_per_year is nominal.

release_schedule.rule: The WCO prepares amendments updating the HS nomenclature every 5-6 years through the Review Sub-Committee and HS Committee; the HS Convention provides a two-and-one-half-year implementation period after adoption before a new edition enters into force (six months for reservations, two years for correlation tables/translation/legislative updates). The HS2022 edition entered into force 1 January 2022; the next edition, originally planned as HS2027, was pushed back one year due to COVID-19-related delays and will be HS2028, entering into force 1 January 2028.
release_schedule.note: This is a periodic amendment/nomenclature update, not a recurring data report with dated calendar entries. The WCO's own site frames it as a 5-6 year revision cycle governed by the HS Convention's implementation timeline rather than a fixed calendar. A further, more fundamental revision (HS2033) is already being planned as a follow-on cycle.

reports.title: ICD-10-CA and the Canadian Classification of Health Interventions (CCI)
reports.description: The companion Canadian clinical classifications maintained and published by CIHI: ICD-10-CA (the Canadian enhancement of the WHO's ICD-10 for diseases and health problems) and CCI (health interventions). Published together as versioned classification releases with accompanying Canadian Coding Standards, they are the coding standard for hospital data submissions.
reports.cadence_note: Versioned releases roughly every three years — v2015, v2018, v2022, with v2025/v2027 enhancement cycles under way — with coding-standard updates in between. releases_per_year is nominal.

entries.covers: Next CCI / Canadian Coding Standards version (fiscal year 2027-2028); ICD-10-CA itself remains frozen at its 2022 version with no further updates planned

release_schedule.rule: CIHI is postponing implementation of new versions of CCI and the Canadian Coding Standards until fiscal year 2027-2028. Separately, CIHI will no longer be updating ICD-10-CA at all, aligning with WHO's 2019 halt of ICD-10 updates as the international community moves toward ICD-11.
release_schedule.note: This report bundles ICD-10-CA and CCI, but the two now have divergent status: ICD-10-CA is permanently frozen (CIHI stated it 'will no longer be updating ICD-10-CA'), so only the CCI component will see a future release. CIHI's most recent bulletin (as of mid-2026) postpones the next CCI/Canadian Coding Standards version to fiscal year 2027-2028 (Apr 1, 2027 - Mar 31, 2028) without a specific date yet announced. Prior versions were labeled 'Version 2018' and 'Version 2022,' and the 2025-2026 Classification Tables (an interim update, not a full new version) were released October 2024.
